approvedPlan: Confirm the selected Dashboard project is the BiliDili Ghost identity with project id 02a25032 before observing the run.
Capture a pre-trigger baseline: no active jobs, selected project identity, Recipe/candidate/publication counts and relevant file/log timestamps.
